subject: RECORD DELIMITER clause
notes: "If feature-name-1 is specified, the method used for determining the length of a variable-length record is that associated with feature-name-1 by the implementor" has an EMPTY domain here, and that is a documented posture rather than a gap. The licence is NOT Annex A.3 — item 26 reaches only the STANDARD-1 phrase — but Annex A.1 item 150, which the standard classes as optional ("This item is optional"), read with A.1's preamble ("Optional: The element may be provided at the implementor's option") and §4.2.5 ¶1 (the clause that governs the A.1 list: its provisions reach "optional language elements for which an implementor claims support", cite.py --check 4.2.5 OK; §4.2.7 is scoped to the Annex A.4 list, kb/Work PB593). docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7 A.1 item 150 records the determination as "Not provided.", which is exactly the shape owner decision kb/Work PB280 Q1 (2026-09-02) closes as DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT through the `a1-optional-not-provided` selector. The row closes on a diagnosis: a feature-name written anyway draws COBOL1778 by name at every edition.
